entities.title: User
entities.definition: A resident or visitor using the service to discover, evaluate and plan participation in events in Kaliningrad Oblast.

confidence.basis: Explicit product and analytics scope.

entities.title: Owner and operator
entities.definition: The product owner and operators who curate supply, publish releases, monitor runtime, recover incidents and make product decisions.

confidence.basis: Explicit operations, release and incident contracts.

entities.title: Future partner
entities.definition: A reserved stakeholder lane for organizations, venues and other partners; concrete needs, Jobs and outcomes require separate research.

confidence.basis: Explicit instruction to retain the lane without inventing partner meaning.

entities.title: Discover a worthwhile event without scanning scattered sources
entities.definition: The user needs a bounded, understandable way to find an event suitable for their time, interests and location without manually monitoring many channels.

confidence.basis: North Star, cards-to-value target and product surface scope.

unresolved_conflicts: No production-wide task-completion baseline yet proves the need is consistently met outside accepted Search health cells.

entities.title: Trust that the event information is current and coherent
entities.definition: The user needs date, time, status, place, admission, media and destination links to describe the same current event across every surface.

confidence.basis: Acceptance inventory, publication contracts and production incidents.

unresolved_conflicts: Recent lifecycle incidents prove the invariant can be violated despite implemented publication paths.

entities.title: Understand enough to decide whether an event is worth attending
entities.definition: The user needs a clear event description, media, key facts, occurrence choices, venue context, admission and related options sufficient for a decision.

confidence.basis: Event-detail feature and acceptance scenarios.

unresolved_conflicts: Engaged detail views and intent actions are defined, but decision confidence is not directly measured.

entities.title: Turn an interesting event into a practical attendance plan
entities.definition: The user needs to preserve, share, calendar, register, buy, route or transport the exact selected event occurrence without false success.

confidence.basis: User acceptance scenarios and analytics intent-action taxonomy.

unresolved_conflicts: Native share, external calendars, maps and third-party submission outcomes still require native or authoritative evidence.

entities.title: Recover when search, identity, data or network conditions fail
entities.definition: The user needs an honest alternative path when results are empty, dynamic services fail, authorization is unavailable or a saved state becomes stale.

confidence.basis: Acceptance inventory and static-core degradation contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Recovery coverage differs by route and capability; no single production coverage score exists.

entities.title: Reduce repeated scanning while retaining discovery diversity
entities.definition: A returning user needs saved state and explainable personalization to surface likely relevant events sooner without a hard information bubble.

confidence.basis: Personalization contracts and explicit <=30 target exist; full production outcome is not proven.

unresolved_conflicts: Current product has local/prototype and bounded production slices but no accepted causal uplift proof.

entities.title: Use the service across device, input and accessibility contexts
entities.definition: The core event-discovery journey must remain understandable and operable on mobile and desktop, with keyboard, reduced motion, no-JS and degraded network behavior where applicable.

confidence.basis: Explicit browser/device and accessibility acceptance inventory.

unresolved_conflicts: Native Safari, screen-reader and high-contrast release evidence remains incomplete for several routes.

entities.title: Discover an event worth considering
entities.definition: Make progress from an open intention to do something in Kaliningrad Oblast to at least one event that merits closer evaluation.

confidence.basis: Product North Star and repeated feature/analytics decisions.

unresolved_conflicts: The historical pilot represented this as the whole model; it is only one root Job among several linked Jobs.

supersession_history.to: accepted root Job within the expanded registry

entities.title: Evaluate an event and decide whether it fits
entities.definition: Progress from a promising card or recommendation to a sufficiently informed attend, save, defer or reject decision.

confidence.basis: Event detail anatomy, acceptance and intent metrics.

unresolved_conflicts: The service can observe engaged reading and actions but not infer confidence from clicks alone.

entities.title: Find events from a specific intent expressed in natural language
entities.definition: Translate a genre, time, mood, activity or other explicit intent into a bounded event result or an honest no-match path.

confidence.basis: Current Search contract and accepted production-health evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Accepted health proves the bounded journey works, not that arbitrary intents satisfy the user at a target rate.

entities.title: Turn a chosen event into an actionable attendance plan
entities.definition: Preserve or transmit the exact event occurrence and obtain the next practical step: calendar, share, ticket, registration, route or transport.

confidence.basis: Acceptance scenarios and strong-action taxonomy.

unresolved_conflicts: A click to a third-party destination is not equivalent to completed registration or attendance.

entities.title: Return to an event previously saved or acted on
entities.definition: Recover the exact saved event and its current lifecycle state without duplicate or cross-account leakage.

confidence.basis: Favorites requirements and acceptance inventory are strong; complete production evidence is not.

unresolved_conflicts: Local, anonymous and account-backed ownership/reconciliation are not uniformly proven across all surfaces.

entities.title: Receive a more relevant bounded feed without losing variety
entities.definition: Use explicit or accepted preference signals to encounter likely interesting events earlier while preserving exploration and safe fallback.

confidence.basis: Personalization model is detailed but user outcome and causal uplift remain unproven.

unresolved_conflicts: No accepted randomized holdout proves personalization uplift; current route may contain static, contextual or personalized states.

entities.title: Recover a useful path when the primary discovery path fails
entities.definition: Continue browsing or choose another action after no results, timeout, stale data, unavailable dynamic service, identity failure or an invalid saved item.

confidence.basis: Recovery scenarios are explicit across Search, personalization, release and static core contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Recovery is implemented unevenly; route-level coverage must remain explicit rather than aggregated to green.

entities.title: When I have an open intention to do something, help me reach a promising event quickly
entities.definition: When I want to choose what to do but have not fixed a title or venue, I want a bounded, current and diverse set of events so I can find one worth considering without scanning scattered channels.

confidence.basis: Direct expression of the accepted discovery Job and North Star.

entities.title: When an event looks promising, help me decide whether it fits
entities.definition: When I open a promising event, I want coherent facts, media and practical context so I can decide to attend, save, defer or reject it.

confidence.basis: Event detail and acceptance contracts.

entities.title: When I can describe what I want, search by that intent and be honest about the result
entities.definition: When I can describe a genre, time or activity, I want the service to return a small exact result or an honest no-match state so I can continue without guessing whether the search failed.

confidence.basis: Search brief, current contract and live health evidence.

entities.title: When I choose an event, preserve the exact occurrence and next step
entities.definition: When I decide an event may fit, I want to save, share, calendar, register or route the exact occurrence so the plan remains usable later and on the intended external service.

confidence.basis: Strong-action and acceptance inventories.

entities.title: When I return later, show the current state of what I saved
entities.definition: When I return to a saved event, I want the same logical event with its current date, status and actions so I do not act on stale or another account's state.

confidence.basis: Accepted requirements with incomplete production evidence.

entities.title: When the service knows accepted preferences, surface relevance earlier without trapping me
entities.definition: When I have provided meaningful preference signals, I want likely relevant events earlier while still seeing controlled new and diverse options.

confidence.basis: Detailed target contract without accepted outcome uplift.

entities.title: When the primary path cannot complete, give me an honest alternative
entities.definition: When search, identity, network or data state prevents the intended path, I want a clear explanation and a useful fallback so I can continue browsing or retry safely.

confidence.basis: Explicit recovery acceptance and degradation contracts.

entities.title: A relevant event is found within 30 unique cards
entities.definition: The user reaches at least one event-value result without seeing more than 30 unique cards, when a suitable event exists in the eligible inventory.

confidence.basis: Explicit analytics and personalization target.

unresolved_conflicts: The denominator must exclude contexts where the current inventory has no suitable event; target-wide production evidence is not yet available.

entities.title: The user can make an informed event decision
entities.definition: After using event detail, the user has enough coherent information to choose attend/save/defer/reject rather than abandoning because essential context is missing or contradictory.

confidence.basis: Feature intent is strong; direct confidence evidence is missing.

unresolved_conflicts: Engagement and CTA are proxies, not direct proof of confidence or satisfaction.

entities.title: The selected intent action completes without false success
entities.definition: A save, calendar, share, route, registration or ticket attempt either reaches its authoritative success condition or returns an honest recoverable failure.

confidence.basis: Strong-action and reliability contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Some external destinations provide only navigation-attempt evidence, not terminal outcome callbacks.

entities.title: The user receives either a usable result or an honest recovery path
entities.definition: Search and discovery never present a silent empty surface or false success; the user receives exact results, an explicit no-result explanation, a fallback or a safe retry path.

confidence.basis: Search and degradation acceptance contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Accepted Search health covered a bounded query and platform matrix, not all data/error contexts.

entities.title: Saved event state remains recoverable and current
entities.definition: The user can return to a unique saved event, see its current lifecycle state and avoid duplicates, stale occurrence data or another account's state.

confidence.basis: Requirements exist; production evidence is incomplete.

unresolved_conflicts: Account merge, cross-tab synchronization and lifecycle reconciliation are not uniformly evidenced.

entities.title: The user acts on coherent current event facts
entities.definition: Visible card, detail, structured data, calendar, share and outbound destinations agree on critical event identity and lifecycle facts.

confidence.basis: Explicit parity scenarios and incidents proving impact.

unresolved_conflicts: Recent stale repost incident prevents a blanket healthy claim.

entities.title: The service becomes a regularly used event-choice channel
entities.definition: A growing share of actors return after reaching event value rather than using the product only once.

confidence.basis: Explicit analytics outcome and retention questions.

unresolved_conflicts: Unified production actor/session aggregates are not yet fully implemented.

entities.title: Fewer sessions end without event value
entities.definition: The share of eligible sessions with no engaged event, save, calendar, share, route, ticket or registration action decreases without harming diversity or access.

confidence.basis: North Star and explicit owner outcome examples.

unresolved_conflicts: No complete production denominator exists across all routes and consent states.

entities.title: Maintain trustworthy, diverse and current regional coverage
entities.definition: The published catalog represents current events across relevant cities, themes and formats without stale, duplicate or fabricated facts.

confidence.basis: Release, catalog, acceptance and incident evidence.

unresolved_conflicts: Critical data progression and root release remain NO-GO; recent incident shows lifecycle risk.

entities.title: Operate the service within reliability, privacy and resource budgets
entities.definition: Product value is delivered without uncontrolled LLM, database, network, storage, privacy or operational cost and without false success.

confidence.basis: Analytics, release, Search and action-map guardrails.

unresolved_conflicts: A recent release-time backup briefly exhausted production disk margin despite successful recovery.

entities.title: Make product decisions from reviewed traceable evidence
entities.definition: The owner can trace a question through evidence, finding, decision and follow-up without treating clicks, UI existence or a green test as outcome proof.

confidence.basis: Product methodology, analysis and action-map contracts.

unresolved_conflicts: Product Atlas v1 establishes traceability but many outcome slots remain explicitly unmeasured.

entities.title: Future partner needs
entities.definition: Reserved placeholder; no partner need is asserted before dedicated research.

confidence.basis: Absence is explicit and intentional.

unresolved_conflicts: Dedicated partner research has not been performed.

entities.title: Future partner Jobs
entities.definition: Reserved placeholder; no partner Job is asserted before dedicated research.

confidence.basis: Absence is explicit and intentional.

unresolved_conflicts: Dedicated partner research has not been performed.

entities.title: Future partner outcomes
entities.definition: Reserved placeholder; no partner outcome is asserted before dedicated research.

confidence.basis: Absence is explicit and intentional.

unresolved_conflicts: Dedicated partner research has not been performed.
